_about: Mayors of Metro Vancouver's municipalities beyond the City, for the card's Representatives beyond the City (representatives.py writes them to representatives.json as region_mayors, keyed by the municipality's name in base.geojson). Hand-kept: the October 17, 2026 general local elections (2026–2030 term), checked November 16, 2026 against Daily Hive's list of Metro Vancouver mayoral winners, CTV and CP24's results (Richmond's narrow result confirmed by Mayor Howard's inauguration on November 2). Anmore and Belcarra were acclaimed. Lions Bay is left out until its result is confirmed. Electoral Area A, Tsawwassen and the reserves have no mayor. Links go to the municipality's website.
